plugins.name: zaha
plugins.description: Roadmap-driven project workflow: keep milestones, bugs and history in plain Markdown next to your code, and plan the next step from them.

skills.name: bug
skills.description: Log a bug to docs/BUGS.md with an ID, severity and the roadmap milestone it belongs to, without fixing it. `/zaha:bug list` shows open bugs.
headings: B-007 [high] M2 · Login fails on Safari
skills.description_zh: 将缺陷以ID、严重程度及所属路线图里程碑记录到docs/BUGS.md，仅登记不修复，并可列出开放缺陷。

skills.name: handoff
skills.description: Before /clear, write a short handoff of the current session (goal, state, decisions, exact next step) so a fresh session can continue without the old context.
skills.description_zh: 在清空会话前记录简短交接，包含目标、当前状态、决策和准确下一步，使新会话能够续接。

skills.name: planning
skills.description: Pick what to work on (a roadmap task, a bug, or a new idea), clear up what is unclear by asking one question at a time, write a step-by-step plan, and implement only after I approve it.
skills.description_zh: 选择路线图任务、缺陷或新想法作为工作对象，逐个问题澄清后写出分步计划，获得用户批准后实施。

skills.name: recap
skills.description: Summarize what changed since the last recap (commits, uncommitted work, decisions from this session) into docs/HISTORY.md, tick finished roadmap tasks and fixed bugs, and suggest the next step.
skills.description_zh: 将上次回顾以来的提交、未提交工作及会话决策写入docs/HISTORY.md，勾选完成任务和已修复缺陷，并提出下一步。

skills.name: roadmap
skills.description: Build or show the project roadmap in docs/ROADMAP.md (milestones with checkable tasks). First run scaffolds it from git history, docs and existing STATUS/BACKLOG files; later runs show where the project is and what comes next.
skills.description_zh: 创建或展示docs/ROADMAP.md中的项目路线图与可勾选任务；首次依据Git历史、文档及既有状态或待办文件生成，后续展示进度和下一事项。

skills.name: test
skills.description: Run the project's tests, affected ones first, with filtered output, and report failures briefly. Offers to log pre-existing failures as bugs.
skills.description_zh: 运行项目测试，优先受影响部分并过滤输出，简短报告失败，可把原有失败登记为缺陷。

skills.name: what
skills.description: Re-explain the last message in plain words when it didn't land.
skills.description_zh: 当上一条消息未被理解时，用朴素易懂的语言重新解释。
